description.value: The Old Caboose Restaurant is a Clearwater landmark originally constructed from a historic local railway caboose, giving the dining room a genuinely distinctive character. It serves a broad all-day menu spanning breakfast, burgers, pizza, pasta, and seafood, with a fully licensed pub on site. Situated on Highway 5 directly across from the Wells Gray Tourist Information building, it sits at a natural gateway for cyclists heading into Wells Gray Provincial Park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates all OSM contact details (name, address, phone, URL). Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'All menu items available for takeout' on the website. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, wi-fi, or any cycling-specific amenity appears in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null per evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and a broad menu. A natural resupply and meal stop for cyclists on the Highway 5 corridor near Wells Gray Provincial Park.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Omelet (mushrooms, green pepper, tomato), House Salad, Greek Salad, and other vegetable-based items. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
